# NEW 2026-11-18 fourth round D2 (former royal houses). Generated by gen_round4_houses.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, event oe_tm.1 (scopes oe_tm_king, oe_tm_t1). The former ruler is at hand: the same test as options a
# and b of oe_tm.1 (KING_OK in gen_territory_middle.py). Links guarded: trigger blocks do not short-circuit.
oe_tnh_king_ok = {
    exists = scope:oe_tm_king
    exists = scope:oe_tm_t1
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_king exists = scope:oe_tm_t1 }
        scope:oe_tm_king = { is_alive = yes }
        scope:oe_tm_t1 = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
    }
}
# Character scope. Alive, with a dynasty that is not on the roll and not the ruling dynasty of BYZ (the author's
# oe_nf_promotion_family without its head count).
oe_tnh_house_free = {
    is_alive = yes
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_dynasty = yes }
        dynasty = {
            NOT = { oe_nf_registered_family = yes }
            NOT = { oe_nf_is_ruling_dynasty = yes }
        }
    }
    trigger_else = { always = no }
}
# Any scope. The roll is set up, has a free slot (fewer than 4 of the slots 1-4 filled) and is below its house limit
# (as the author's oe_nf_can_promote).
oe_tnh_roll_room = {
	exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        has_variable = oe_nf_initialized
        oe_nf_house_count < 4
        trigger_if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_house_limit }
            oe_nf_house_count < var:oe_nf_house_limit
        }
        trigger_else = { always = no }
    }
}
# BYZ scope, event oe_tm.1. The choice 列入豪族名册 is shown.
oe_tnh_roll_ok = {
    oe_tnh_king_ok = yes
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_king }
        scope:oe_tm_king = { oe_tnh_house_free = yes }
    }
    trigger_else = { always = no }
    oe_tnh_roll_room = yes
}
# Character scope. More than 5 living members of the house are owned by BYZ (the head count of the author's
# oe_nf_promotion_family; the character counts too).
oe_tnh_kin_ok = {
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_dynasty = yes }
        dynasty = { any_character_in_dynasty = { count > 5 oe_nf_living = yes owner ?= c:BYZ } }
    }
    trigger_else = { always = no }
}
# BYZ scope, event oe_tm.1. The house would enter the roll as things stand now.
oe_tnh_roll_sure = {
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_king }
        scope:oe_tm_king = { oe_tnh_kin_ok = yes }
    }
    trigger_else = { always = no }
}
# Character scope. The character's house is on the roll.
oe_tnh_on_roll = {
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_dynasty = yes }
        dynasty = { oe_nf_registered_family = yes }
    }
    trigger_else = { always = no }
}
# Character scope. Test pick: a living member of the BYZ court, not a ruler, whose house could join the roll.
oe_tnh_test_candidate = {
    oe_nf_living = yes
    is_ruler = no
    owner ?= c:BYZ
    oe_tnh_house_free = yes
}
